acceptance: The exact v0.5.65 release.json and release-digests.json assets are downloaded from the provider, their SHA-256 values are verified, and both bind source commit 5c65e2c6ac6cb3bd5623393baeee822d75ec0248.

scripts/sync_published_release_projection.py promotes only those verified provider bytes, sets repository release.json and release-digests.json to v0.5.65, records release-state.json as candidate_prepared with previousRelease v0.5.65, and advances next-release.json and .ai/cockpit/version.json exactly to v0.5.66.

check-release-distribution, check-release-distribution-post-publish, check-release-state-consistency, check-release-evidence, and the declared release preflight/quality checks pass on the synchronized branch.

After install.sh changes, the canonical source-bound capability, Japanese capability, and pre-release documentation alignment generators are rerun so every evidenceSource digest matches the current bytes.

The canonical supply-chain evidence refresh regenerates the committed SBOM and provenance projection from the exact published v0.5.65 source identity, and check-sbom/check-provenance pass without hand-editing generated evidence.
The Work Item is archived only with a direct green Outcome in the conversation, then its PR is merged and ai-close-work-item proves clean base synchronization and branch cleanup.
guidelines: Use the canonical synchronizer; do not hand-edit generated release projections or invent provider evidence.
Keep immutable provider facts separate from the unpublished candidate and preserve fail-closed source/tag/digest checks.
Do not treat the successful publication run as evidence that the repository projection is synchronized until the post-publish checks pass.

intent.problem: The public v0.5.65 release was published successfully from the merged source commit, but the repository release.json projection remained at v0.5.64. This makes check-release-distribution fail and leaves the repository, installer, and provider release truths out of sync.
constraints: Use only provider-verified v0.5.65 release.json and release-digests.json bytes bound to source commit 5c65e2c6ac6cb3bd5623393baeee822d75ec0248.
Do not change or delete the immutable v0.5.65 tag, GitHub Release, assets, or source archive.
Use the existing synchronizer and governed PR lifecycle; do not bypass generated evidence or protected-main controls.
intent.rationale: The root fix is to complete the intentionally separate post-publication promotion boundary. Synchronizing the provider-verified public projection and advancing the next candidate restores a single coherent release state without mutating immutable evidence.

rawUserRequest: 完成既定目标并发布新版本；发现问题必须找到根因解决，Outcome 未达到绿色不得结束，必须把发布后的仓库与 provider release 真值同步完整。
